items.title: End of the 'Lag 7'? What Nvidia's earnings mean for the rest of tech.
items.summary: Slatestone Wealth Chief Market Strategist Kenny Polcari, F.L. Putnam Investment Management Co. items.title: Apple (AAPL) Brings Emergency SOS Live Video To Brazil
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) is expanding its Emergency SOS Live Video feature to iPhone users in Brazil, marking the tool's first rollout outside the US. The service allows users to share encrypted real time video with emergency responders during critical incidents. The expansion broadens Apple's public safety tools in a key international market as of late August 2026. items.title: Will Nvidia or Apple Have The Bigger Market Cap By The End of Q3?
items.summary: NVIDIA just posted triple-digit growth and Apple called its strongest June quarter ever, but only one of them will hold the largest market cap on earth when Q3 closes. The gap is narrower than either camp wants to admit.
